risks.title: Dependence on ICT component suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified as material in ESRS analysis (S2 potential, upstream). Freenet is fully dependent on international suppliers for mobile devices, components, and infrastructure. Moderate language but context of high geographic exposure (developing countries). Stable trend but structural to the business model.

risks.title: Human rights violations in the supply chain
risks.score_rationale: S2 potential risk identified as material. Explicit exposure to child labor and forced labor risks in mining and component manufacturing. Moderate intensity language but clear recognition of systemic ICT sector risk. Stable trend but long-term structural risk.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and loss of customer/employee data
risks.score_rationale: Company-specific risk identified as material (short/medium/long term). High-intensity language: 'severe consequences', 'data protection violations', 'customer churn'. Positioned as inherent risk to the ICT business model. Trend up: documented increase in cyberattacks in the sector.

risks.title: Rising costs from CO2 pricing
risks.score_rationale: E1 potential risk identified as material (short/medium/long term). Moderate language but explicit recognition of financial impact: 'higher costs', 'increased operating expenses'. Resilience analysis concludes on significant but mitigable gross risk. Trend up: expected regulatory tightening.

risks.title: Inadequate recycling of mobile devices by customers
risks.score_rationale: E5 actual risk identified as material (short/medium term). Freenet acknowledges responsibility for placing devices on the market whose inadequate recycling causes environmental damage. Moderate language, indirect but documented impact. Stable trend but increasing risk with sales volumes.

risks.title: Intense competition and pricing pressure in the mobile sector
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk of freenet's business model (Digital Lifestyle Provider in Germany). Although not explicitly detailed in Item 1A, the context of supplier dependence and the German market structure (3-4 dominant operators) implies structural competition. Trend up: consolidation and price pressure.

risks.title: Compliance and corruption risks in operations
risks.score_rationale: G1 potential risk identified as material (long term). Freenet operates in Germany where corruption is legally prohibited. Moderate language acknowledging systemic risks but assessment of freenet as low exposure. Stable trend: structural risk mitigated by German legal framework.

risks.title: Working conditions and employee satisfaction
risks.score_rationale: S1 actual and potential risk identified as material (medium/long term). Freenet acknowledges risks of job insecurity, workload, lack of flexibility, and pay inequalities. One documented case of discrimination in 2025. Moderate language but recognition of materiality. Stable trend but increasing risk in uncertain economic context.
